description: This file defines the PlaywrightDispatcher class and related classes for managing Playwright instances, including browser types, Android devices, and SOCKS proxy support. It handles initialization, request creation, and cleanup within the Playwright server context.

classes.name: PlaywrightDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class managing Playwright instances, including browser types, Android devices, and SOCKS proxy support.

classes.name: SocksSupportDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing SOCKS proxy support and related socket events.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the PlaywrightDispatcher with options for pre-launched browsers, Android devices, and SOCKS proxy.

methods.name: newRequest
methods.description: Creates a new API request context and returns its dispatcher.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up browser contexts upon disconnect.
